capacidades.titulo: Aerial inspection and data capture by drone
capacidades.texto: NYOS uses unmanned aerial systems as a tool to support engineering, inspection and the monitoring of infrastructure and works. They make it possible to document areas that are difficult to access, obtain visual information on the condition and progress of the works, and complement inspection, control and technical diagnosis tasks.
Management, representation and analysis of geographic information to support the study of the territory, the planning of works, project documentation and the monitoring of infrastructure.
Creation and processing of three-dimensional models and representations to improve the technical understanding of solutions, support design and make projects and works easier to communicate.

capacidades.titulo: Technical photography and documentary record of works
capacidades.texto: Orderly graphic documentation of works, progress, incidents and singular elements to support technical assistance, site supervision and reports.
